explication: Mimi is a cross-platform live speech-captioning and translation app. The desktop workflow selects system audio, microphone, or an application; starts a session; processes speech through a configured recognition/translation service; and displays live captions in an adjustable overlay. Desktop also supports optional local session export. Android has a parallel capture, provider, and overlay path. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with visible imports and calls; unsampled subsystem links are omitted or marked unverified.
